name: Graja de Iniesta (Spain)
description: Divided by lines from the lower hoist into four parts, red at the upper hoist, white, green and yellow at the lower fly, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Graja de Iniesta (a horseman and grapes on red).
history: Municipal flag of Graja de Iniesta; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Graja de Iniesta arms — horseman and grapes on red
